classification.difficultyReason: Read both translation signs from each equation and match the cubic's shifted flattening point to a supplied sketch; no graph construction or parameter finding is required.

spec.description: Three finite increasing cubic sketches with bold uppercase A, B and C. Black axes have no ticks, scales, axis labels or arrowheads. Curve segments have no endpoint markers. Drawing coordinates express qualitative positions only.
spec.mathematics: A has its horizontal flattening left of the vertical axis and above the horizontal axis, with a negative x-intercept. B has its flattening right and above, with a positive x-intercept. C has its flattening left and below, with a negative x-intercept.
spec.answerVisibility: All three choices are permanent student-visible givens; no correct-choice indication is printed.

answer.worked: Replacing $x$ with $x+4$ translates the curve 4 units left; replacing $y$ with $y-3$ translates it 3 units up. The horizontal flattening moves from $(0,0)$ to $(-4,3)$, matching A. Correct answer: A.

spec.description: A distinct repeated three-choice set, preserving bold uppercase A, B and C, finite blue cubic segments and black axes without ticks, scales, axis labels, arrowheads or endpoint markers. Drawing coordinates express qualitative positions only.
spec.mathematics: A has its horizontal flattening left of the vertical axis and above the horizontal axis, with a negative x-intercept. B has its flattening right and above, with a positive x-intercept. C has its flattening left and below, with a negative x-intercept.
spec.answerVisibility: All three choices are permanent student-visible givens; no correct-choice indication is printed.

answer.worked: Write the equation as $y-2=(x-3)^3$. Replacing $x$ with $x-3$ translates the curve 3 units right; replacing $y$ with $y-2$ translates it 2 units up. The horizontal flattening moves from $(0,0)$ to $(3,2)$, matching B. Correct answer: B.
